title: Publish a citable methodology page
problem: Comparison answers cite general methods but not the brand's own process.
hypothesis: A clear methodology with original examples may become a stronger source for relevant answers.
action: Publish one canonical methodology page with definitions, steps, limitations, examples, author, and update date.
expected_signal: Brand-controlled methodology page appears in relevant citations or source lists.
measurement: Repeat the baseline comparison queries and record citations.
retest_window: After the page is discoverable, using the original query set.
